messages:
alex: quick follow-up from the PM: we need to close action owners and make timelines explicit. main goals: owners (R), approvers (A), jira links, and a short rollout plan.
maria: i pulled items from the doc. a few are one-off fixes, others are recurring patterns. recommend triage now so owners can start.
sam: i'll take the cache-eviction follow-up — ticket PMT-7342. Plan: investigate root cause, add tests, and propose a fix. R: sam, A: maria, C: raj, I: alex. ETA: EOD Thursday.
raj: got it. i'll help with rollout and will request a rollback checklist be added to the ticket (we saw similar regressions last quarter).
jess: added rollback checklist and a short test plan to PMT-7342. set label `remediation:medium`.
alex: thanks. on the KV-cache TTL drift (PMT-7351) we need temporal analysis and trend graphs. @raj can you own? :eyes:
raj: yes, i'll own PMT-7351. ETA next Tue morning. i'll attach a 30-day incident histogram.
maria: small process ask: let's keep one R and one A per ticket to avoid split acceptance last time.
sam: +1. I'll keep R on 7342, maria will be A for validation.
oncall-bot: Incident PMT-7342 assigned to sam; reminder set for 2026-04-02T15:00:00Z.
jess: PMT-7375 (autoscaler spike) looks like a config drift affecting Dedicated customers. propose R: maria, A: alex, C: eng-sre, I: sales.
alex: agreed. maria, can you add a canary window and owner-runbook steps? if it's risky we should schedule a canary.
maria: scheduled canary Mon 09:00 UTC. added runbook snippet to ticket: ```
# Canary steps
1. deploy config to canary pool
2. monitor error rate and token latency in 2m windows
3. revert if error rate > 0.5% or latency spike > 30%
```
sam: quick question — for recurring patterns, do we put a 'recurring incidents' section in the runbook or use a separate tracker?
raj: prefer separate tracker to track mitigation progress over time. i'll spin up a Grafana dashboard and link to tickets.
jess: created epic PMT-7400 as 'recurring-incident-tracker' and linked 7342, 7351, 7375. please add child tickets as you create them.
alex: timeline lock: 7342 -> EOD Thu (sam), 7351 -> Tue (raj), 7375 -> canary Mon (maria). 15m sync Mon 10:30 UTC to confirm rollouts. everyone, update Jira with acceptance criteria.
maria: filing acceptance criteria now (unit tests + smoke test + rollback steps).
sam: will post investigation notes and remediation PR to PMT-7342 when ready.
raj: draft recurring-incidents dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/recurring-incidents (WIP). feedback please.
alex: who will update the RACI doc to reflect these lanes so handoffs are cleaner?
jess: i'll update the RACI doc and add a "postmortem handback" section with rotation guidance. will open PR and ping for review.
oncall-bot: Reminder: postmortem follow-up sync scheduled in 48h.
alex: thanks all, marking this thread as 'followup in progress'. reconvene Mon 10:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
